{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out consensus linkage breakage in standalone builds, linter regex gaps, and commit ordering breaking CI lint"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230879",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Standalone libbitcoin_consensus build breaks because AssertUnreachable introduces an unwanted dependency from interpreter.cpp into util/check.cpp",
      "quote": "calls assertion_fail from util/check.cpp. This file is in libbitcoin_consensus, which should only depend on crypto. Normal builds hide it, bitcoin_common pulls util in anyway, but the riscv job links ",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author excluded consensus from assert_falsy",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901616096",
        "rc:4529566139"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4529566139",
      "status_by_quote": "thx, excluded for now"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230883",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The assert_falsy linter regex misses falsy assertions with variable whitespace or 0&&\"x\"",
      "quote": "The message says any falsy literal, but the regex hardcodes the spacing, so assert (false), assert(false ) and assert(0&&\"x\") all slip through.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted suggested regex",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901611212"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3901611212",
      "status_by_quote": "Thx, used that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230883",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Catch compiler-specific __builtin_unreachable() in the linter in addition to std::unreachable",
      "quote": "Worth catching the builtin too?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained risk is low for compiler-specific built-ins",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901611212"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3901611212",
      "status_by_quote": "I think the risk of someone using it should be low, because it is a compiler-specific built-in."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230890",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "The commit introducing the linter fails CI lint mid-history because the scripted-diff fix is placed in a subsequent commit",
      "quote": "The scripted-diff that satisfies this linter is the next commit, so lint is red here, 135 lines. Swapping the two applies cleanly and gives the same tree.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author swapped commits to keep history green",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901611711"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3901611711",
      "status_by_quote": "Thx, swapped commits"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Added part 2 to rc:3887230883 for the __builtin_unreachable suggestion, which the author answered. Updated rc:3887230879 to fixed following the author's resolution in rc:4529566139.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "jeanpablojp to re-review after author addressed all items and pushed fixes",
      "id": "rc:4529566139"
    }
  ]
}
